fields.description: Coral Beach Villas is Sobha Siniya Island’s beachfront villa collection in Umm Al Quwain. The current developer page offers five- and six-bedroom homes, while the linked earlier brochure provides detailed five-bedroom Type A and B drawings. Gardens, pools and the beach setting are central to the design, with each villa’s plot and included works requiring its own specification.

overview: The earlier five-bedroom drawings include lifts, separate service spaces and roof accommodation. Type A and Type B have different saleable areas and plot ranges; these historical examples do not establish the six-bedroom release’s size or availability.
